annotations.description: Node {{ $labels.instance }} has rebooted {{ $value | humanize }} seconds ago.
Node {{ $labels.instance }} has rebooted {{ $value | humanize }} seconds ago.

spec.name: WindowsNodeHasRebooted
spec.query:
(time() - windows_system_boot_time_timestamp_seconds{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}
or
time() - windows_system_boot_time_timestamp{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}
or
time() - windows_system_system_up_time{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}) < 600
and
((time() - windows_system_boot_time_timestamp_seconds{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"} offset 10m)
or
(time() - windows_system_boot_time_timestamp{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"} offset 10m)
or
(time() - windows_system_system_up_time{job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"} offset 10m)) > 600
